script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', k.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', k.progress_message, 'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.key}}' AND k.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS gr_id, g.gr_no, g.gr_status, g.organization_id, CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.goods_receiving_id = {{node:code_node_VSguard.data.grId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0) AS line_count,
       (SELECT p.step_name FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'GRC|{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.grId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', o.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', o.progress_message, 'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command IN ('COMPLETE_GR', 'REVERT_GR') AND o.correlation_id = 'GR|{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.grId}}' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED',
		'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GR', 'COMMITTING_REVERT', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', x.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', x.progress_message, 'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'REVERT_GR' AND x.correlation_id = 'GR|{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.grId}}' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN goods_receiving g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VSguard.data.grId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

		g.`supplier_contact_number`, 'supplier_email', g.`supplier_email`, 'gr_no', g.`gr_no`, 'gr_received_by', g.`gr_received_by`, 'gr_date', DATE_FORMAT(g.`gr_date`,

		1, 23), 'update_user', g.`update_user`, 'update_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(g.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted', g.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id',

		'is_parent_split', g.`is_parent_split`, 'grn_uuid', g.`grn_uuid`, 'posted_status', g.`posted_status`, 'billing_address_fax', g.`billing_address_fax`, 'shipping_address_fax',

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', l.`id`, 'goods_receiving_id', l.`goods_receiving_id`, 'item_id', l.`item_id`, 'item_name', l.`item_name`, 'received_qty', l.`received_qty`,
		'line_po_id', l.`line_po_id`, 'return_quantity', l.`return_quantity`, 'po_line_item_id', l.`po_line_item_id`, 'line_index', l.`line_index`, 'base_received_qty',
		l.`base_received_qty`, 'parent_index', l.`parent_index`, 'parent_or_child', l.`parent_or_child`, 'is_split', l.`is_split`, 'created_return_qty', l.`created_return_qty`,
		'parent_id', l.`parent_id`, 'item_bundle_id', l.`item_bundle_id`) AS j,
       (SELECT i.serial_number_management FROM item i WHERE i.id = l.item_id AND i.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS sn
  FROM goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l
 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.goods_receiving_id = {{node:code_node_VSentry.data.grId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY l.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(m.`id` AS CHAR), 'transaction_type', m.`transaction_type`, 'movement', m.`movement`, 'trx_no', m.`trx_no`, 'parent_trx_no', m.`parent_trx_no`,
		'item_id', CAST(m.`item_id` AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(m.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'bin_location_id', CAST(m.`bin_location_id` AS CHAR), 'batch_number_id', CAST(m.`batch_number_id` AS CHAR),
		'handling_unit_id', CAST(m.`handling_unit_id` AS CHAR), 'inventory_category', m.`inventory_category`, 'quantity', CAST(m.`quantity` AS CHAR), 'base_qty', CAST(m.`base_qty` AS CHAR),
		'uom_id', CAST(m.`uom_id` AS CHAR), 'base_uom_id', CAST(m.`base_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'unit_price', CAST(m.`unit_price` AS CHAR), 'costing_method_id', m.`costing_method_id`) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN inventory_movement m
    ON m.id > g.id AND m.organization_id = g.organization_id AND m.is_deleted = 0
   AND (m.trx_no = g.gr_no OR COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = g.gr_no)
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VSentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY m.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id, j.job_status, j.correlation_id,
       g.gr_status, g.gr_no, CAST(g.gr_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS gr_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('GRC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  LEFT JOIN goods_receiving g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_VSguard.data.key}}' AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
